item.title: Skeleton's Daycare
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: I don't really know, maybe a bit emotional in some parts?

  • Elevator Pitch
  • Central Narrative
  • Hook/Attention Grabber
  • Additional Notes

It's a daycare owned by a living skeleton. The skeleton itself isn't anomalous (though it can talk, which skeletons aren't able to do, but that's about it), it's just a normal human who decomposed into a skeleton but is still alive due to some crystals on the walls.

There's no other staff in the daycare, but what they do have are alien children to take care of. For the most part, they're fairly normal. They have a bit of a temper, but that's just kids being kids. They are capable of causing minor earthquakes though, so you might not wanna anger them too badly.

This daycare used to be pretty normal. Then these alien parents came in and had to drop their kids off because "they had to do something (translation: they were being abandoned)." When they left the kids at the daycare, they left them with some crystals that would make them immortal.

Two people used to run the daycare, but the original owner left to go find the parents because they've been gone for way too long and they can't close without all the kids leaving. This left the other guy to run it all by himself, but the owner was out for so long that the other guy's body died and became a skeleton.

After some time, one of the alien parents came back and took their kid, along with one of the crystals. This caused the skeleton's life to become much harder. This, along with the stress of taking care of aliens, was adding up.

At some point, the skeleton couldn't take it anymore and just left the building, causing him to die from getting out of range from the crystals. The children were attached to him after living there for a long time, so they tried to bring him inside and get him to live again, but it didn't work. Remember in the Elevator Pitch how the kids could cause minor earthquakes? They're really upset now, and they're causing serious damage to the rest of the world. They tried calming them down, but nothing would work. Because of the danger and the fact that the parents weren't coming back, they had to neutralize them.

A daycare slowly going into ruins.

[Note from the owner: Kill me.]
